description: Dutch East India Company captured the fort from the Portuguese with support from the Kingdom of Kandy and began Dutch control of Galle.
British forces took control of Galle Fort from the Dutch during the Napoleonic wars and continued using the fort as an administrative and military center.
Princess Hemamala and Prince Danta brought the sacred Tooth Relic of Lord Buddha from India to Sri Lanka.
The Kandyan Convention of 1815 transferred sovereignty of the Kandyan Kingdom to the British marking the end of the Tooth Relic’s role as a symbol of royal authority.

event_name: Planting of the Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi
description: The sacred Bo sapling from Bodh Gaya was planted in Anuradhapura by Sanghamitta Theri.
King Devanampiyatissa embraced Buddhism and developed Anuradhapura as the first Buddhist capital.
King Kashyapa built the Sigiriya rock citadel as his royal palace and defensive stronghold.
The world-famous frescoes depicting celestial maidens were painted on the western rock face.
